༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che'i cha lag brda don gsal ba/brda chig brgyud/mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang /sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi phyag len gsal bar bshad

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che'i cha lag brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi phyag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra dha ra buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag brda'i tshul gyis gnang ba 'di'i byin rlabs bya ba la gnyis te slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma la bya ba'o/ /dang po ni kyai rdo rje lha dgu'am bdag med lha mo bco lnga gang rung gi bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ba dang bcas pa byas te/ mdun du maṇḍal mchod chog tshul bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni slob ma lam 'bras kyi khrid rdzogs par thob cing 'di'i byin rlabs don du gnyer ba la grangs nges mi mdzad nyer lnga sogs ci tsam yod pa rnams khrus byas yon phul gral du 'khod pa la/ 'o 'di'i don nyams su len par byed pa la man ngag gi gleng gzhi dang / byin rlabs kyi rim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang / mthar sa chen gyis rje btsun la ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni 'brog mi nas brgyud pa rnams yin te/ 'brom dang zha ma la sogs pa dang gdams pa thun mong ba yin pas so/ /gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa sa dkar logs la rgyab yol byas/ 'bal grog dang mon grog gi bar skyil krung gcig gis khebs par mdzad pa'i dus su dpal ldan sa skyar zla ba gcig gi bar du bzhugs te sa chen kun dga' snying po la bla med dang mthun par bkral ba'i rgyud sde bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bshad pa dang / gsung ngag lam 'bras yongs su rdzogs par gnang zhing / gzhan yang lcags ri'i khongs kyi chos bzhir grags pa'i phyi nang gi lam zab thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang /

birwa pa'i bsrung ba thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang / lam sbas bshad/ rnam 'joms bir lugs dang bzhi dang / yang grub chen bcu phra mo brgyad la sogs pa gdam ngag mtha' yas pa gnang nas gsung rab ma lus pa'i mdzod du gyur pa yin no/ /de dag la dgongs nas rje btsun rtse mos lam 'bras kyi phyag dper/ ye shes zla ba dri med mig la shar/ /sde snod gsum gyis de nyid gsal bar byas/ /rgya mtsho'i nang na nor bu bzhin du mdzes/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rtogs 'gyur gzhan gyis min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje btsun grags pas kyang / bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /zhes sogs shlau ka bzhi gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni rje btsun chen po dgung lo nyer drug bzhes pa'i dus su ru mtshams gzhu'i gtsug lag khang du chos dbar mdzad pa'i tshe rje btsun chen po'i mnal lam du sa skya pa chen po byon nas rigs kyi bu khyod la sngon ngas bstan pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag thams cad kyi brjed byang 'di yin no gsungs nas/ rdo dkar la 'jam pa yid du 'ong ba gru bzhi pa gcig la padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i phyogs bzhi stong pa/ dbus su hūm̐ am̐/ rlung mtshams nas g.yon skor gyi ya ra la wa rnams kunda ltar kha dog dkar pos bris pa gcig dang / dang po chos nyid gdan du byas/ /gnyis pa rlung la spar zin bya/ /gtum mo'i me drod rab tu sbar/ /byang chub chu rgyun dbu mar gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di rnams snang zhing byin gyis brlabs pas gsung rab thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa yin no/ /des sa skya paṇḍi ta la gdams so/ /gleng bzhi bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni maṇḍal phul nas/ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid ces sogs dang / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/

/dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /yang / kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /dngos gzhi ni slob dpon kyai rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis sngar bshad pa lta bu'i rdo gru bzhi pa de gos dar ram ras dkar po'i steng du bzhag ste/ slob ma rnams kyi lag pa gnyis su byin nas/ sngon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos gsung ngag rin po che'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag brda'i tshul gyis rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pas/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag rtogs shing khong du chud pa bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang slob ma 'di rnams la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag brda'i tshul gyis sbyin zhing byin gyis brlabs pas/ slob ma 'di rnams kyis lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag rtogs shing khong du chud par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes brjod de/ yang de nyid mgo bor bzhag nas hūm̐ am̐ ya ra la wa/ dang po chos nyid gdan du bya/ /zhes sogs brjod pas de'i don khong du chud par bsam mo/ /byin rlabs de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir mgo bor rdo rje bzhag ste tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod do/ /de nas smon lam gdab cing me tog gtor la oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā zhes brjod/ de nas sngar gyi rdo rje'i tshig brda tsam gyis bstan par byas pa'i don gsal bar bshad pa la gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba dang / de'i don nyams su blang ba dang / zhar la byung ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni rdo dkar la 'jam pa yid du 'ong ba ni kun gzhi gnyug ma rang bzhin gyis dag pa sems can kun la khyab cing mi mnyam pa med pa'i brda'o/

/de la padma 'dab brgyad bris pa ni/ kun gzhi de gdod ma nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi dri mas ma gos pa'i brda'o/ /de'i phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma stong pa bzhi ni rgyu 'bras ngo bo nyid med pas te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du mi byed pa bzhis stong pa'i brda'o/ /de dag gis shes rab lta bas thag bcad pa bstan te gdan de'i dbus su am̐ hūm̐ gnyis yab yum gyi sa bon te bum dbang dang / bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa ston pa'i brda'o/ /dang po chos nyid gdan du bya/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /ya yis ni rlung gi sbyor ba bdun dang / ra yis ni gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad bstan te gsang dbang dang / gsang dbang gi lam gyi brda'o/ /wa yis ni zhu bde'i lam bstan te shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang / shes rab ye shes kyi lam gyi brda'o/ /la yis ni sa sogs byang chub kyi sems kyi rba rlabs rengs pa bstan te dbang bzhi pa dang / bzhi pa'i dbang gi lam gyi brda'o/ /de dag gis ni thabs nyams su blang ba'i tshul bstan to/ /gnyis pa rlung la spar zin bya/ /gtum mo'i me drod rab tu sbar/ /byang sems chu rgyun dbu mar gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du sdud/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /lam de dag bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'byung ba ni 'bras bu'i brda'i ste/ ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /rtsa ba'i tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba'o/ /gnyis pa de'i don nyams su blang ba'i tshul rgyas pa ni chos rje sa paṇa dang lho pa rin chen dpal gyi gzhung las shes par bya zhing / de'i ngag 'don mdor bsdus te brda tshig gi tshul gyis bstan pa ni/ gnyis las gsum 'byung gdams ngag ni/ /brda don gsal ba'i 'grel pa dang / /lho pa'i zin bris gnyis po las/ /dmigs thun rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'byung /

/re re'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes/ /dang po yon tan lta ri me/ /bskyed rim res bza' rlung thub pa/ /gtum mo nyes pa zhu bde klu/ /rba rlabs bug ste bug klu 'o/ /lta mtsho bskyed rtse rlung ri 'o/ /gtum mo thub pa zhu bde chu/ /rba rlabs 'byung ba me rtse'o/ /bsdus pa sngon 'gro sngar bzhin te/ /lta ba bskyed rim rlung gtum mo/ /zhu bde rba rlabs bug pa'o/ /lta ba bzhin du byang sems kyang / /lam gyi nyams len ji snyed pa/ /sangs rgyas rgyur 'gyur bya phyir dang / /lha sgom pa ni tha mal gyi/ /rnam rtog bzlog phyir bskyed rim bzhin/ /bla ma bsgoms nas bstim pa ni/ /rdzogs rim ye shes rang rgyud la/ /bskyed phyir yin te gsang sngags dang / /khyad par rdzogs rim rtogs pa yang / /bla ma mchog la rag las phyir/ /'di gsum lta ba bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /don rnams mdor bsdus bstan pa yin/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ /shin tu bsdus na dmigs thun gcig /dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig ma zhes/ /rtsa tshig bsdus pa'i nyams len 'di/ /sgrub pa lung sbyin gzhung bzhin sgom/ /dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun/ /zhes sogs rtsa tshig bsdus pa yin/ /des na khrid tshul rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /zhes pa bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa zhar las byung ba ni 'pho ba grong 'jug bar do/ lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam dang bzhi po ni rdo rje tshig rkang gi 'grel pa gzhung bshad gnyag ma/ dmar ma/ man ngag mdzod la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya ste bgros bzhin bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin no/ /de ltar rang gzhan gyi blo dang bstun pa'i bshad pa tshar nas/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad 'i brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel dang / lho pa rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung rnams kyi lung rdzogs par bya'o/ /rjes ni gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs dang /

bsngo ba byas te slob ma rang gnas su gtong ngo / /slob dpon gyis rjes kyi bya ba maṇḍal mchod chog bzhin bya'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal birwa pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag gi nang tshan brda chig brgyud kyi man ngag ston par byed pa la gnyis te slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma la bya ba'o/ /dang po ni gnas dben par gad dar legs par byas te dkon mchog gi rten dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi mdun du/ chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma lnga tshar bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams bshams nas/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ 'das gtor nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar phul la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid grangs dang bcas pa dang / slob dpon dang slob ma'i bar du yol ba brkyangs nas srung 'khor sgom pa sogs 'di ltar byed kyi brda sprad pa dang / slob ma yol ba'i nang du 'ongs nas brda bstan pa dngos dang / rjes srung 'khor gyi bya ba rdzogs nas mjug gi bya ba dang bzhi'i/ dang po ni/ /slob ma rang nyid la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid kyi dmigs rim rdzogs par thob cing / 'di'i skabs su bab pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs rnams dang / brda don gsal ba'i man ngag dang / gzhung bshad gang rung gi lung rdzogs par thob nas/ sngar nyams len la brtson par byas pa'am phyin chad brtson par byed 'dod pa'i gang zag ste/ lam 'di'i sgo nas bar chad sel zhing dngos grub thob par 'dod pas/ rnam gsum rigs dbye'i sgo nas blang dor shes nas nyams su len par 'dod pa'i dad ldan gyi slob ma lnga las mi mang ba la mdzad pa phyag len yin no/ /gnyis pa ni slob ma lnga las mi mang ba khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon dang maṇḍal phul te/

kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du brda chig brgyud kyi gdam ngag zab mo zhus nas tshul bzhin du nyams su blang snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems skyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ gdam ngag 'di shin tu zab cing gces spras su byas nas gsang ba'i tshul gyis nyams su len par byed dgos pas/ de'ang 'dir rje btsun birwa pa'i man ngag gi nang tshan gegs sel gyi gdam ngag yin no/ /de'ang bdud stobs 'phel ba'i bdud byung na nang gi bdud la bsad pa bzhis bsrung ba'ang 'jug cing / gtso cher dbang bzhi'i brda shes pas bsrung ste/ lus kyi sgo'i brdas bsrung ba/ ngag gis gsang mtshan gsang ba la sogs pas bsrung zhing / sems kyis srung 'khor sgom pa la sogs pas bsrung ngo / /brda'i sgo nas bsrung ba ni lung dang sbyar na brtag gnyis las/ gang gis sor mo gcig ston pa/ /gnyis kyis legs par 'ong ba yin/ /zhes sogs lus kyi brda' dang / bde mchog nyung ngu las/ skyes pa la ḍa dang bud med la ḍi sogs ngag gi brda dang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang las shes rab la phyi'i bdud lam gnyis lta grub brgyad sgyur ba 'ong / nang lam sogs bcu dang brda ma shes na 'ong / shes pas bsrung zhes sogs dang / shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i lam la lha'i bu'i bdud 'ong bas bsad pa bzhis bsrung / zhes gsungs shing / gzhung bshad a seng ma las kyang / thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gnyis la bar chad 'jug cing gcig la min/ /bsrung ba brgyad brgyad bcu drug dag tu ste/ /thabs la dad pa la sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /shes rab bsad pa rnam pa bzhi yis bsrung / /nang gi bdud la dbang bzhi'i brda yis bzlog /gnyis pa thun mong bsrung ba bcu bzhi ste/ /dang po lam du 'jug dang zhugs pa dang /

/sems 'dzin cung zad brtan dang cher brtan pas/ /bar chad rim gyis sel ba shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don skabs 'dir shes rab kyi phyogs su lhungs pa'i gang zag la gzugs ston pa'i mthong snang dang / sgra brjod pa'i nyams snang sogs gang byung yang yi dam gyi lha yin nam/ bdud yin nam/ nyams snang yin brtag dpyad dgos pas rnam gsum rigs dbye byas te/ de la yang sad pa bzhis bsrung ba dang / dbang bzhi'i brdas bsrung ba gnyis las/ dang po la nyams kyi sad pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sad pa/ sngags kyi sad pa/ lta grub kyi sad pa dang bzhi'i sgo nas bsrung ngo / /gnyis pa dbang bzhi'i brdas bsrung ba la lus brda la rtsa'i brda bzhi dang / yan lag gi brda bzhi ste brgyad/ ngag brda la yi ge bzhi tshan bzhi ste 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i bshad pa ji ltar rigs par bya zhing / gzhung bshad kyi skabs su yang 'di'i thad ka la bklags lung 'chad pa tsam byed la/ bshad pa dang lag pa'i brda sprod sogs mi bya/ 'di'i man ngag zur du ston pa'i phyag len mdzad pa yin pas/ dpon slob rnams kyis srung 'khor bsgoms te uṣṇi ṣa gsum yan chad bzlas tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis se gol gyi brda byas la/ slob ma dang po des uṣṇi ṣa bzla bzhin du yol ba'i nang du slob dpon gyi drung du 'ong / gzhan rnams kyis gsung mi chag par 'don/ brdab stan tshar ba dang tshur 'ong mkhan dang phar 'gro mkhan gnyis kas bzlas shing / mjug tu thams cad la bstan tshar ba dang srung 'khor gyi gsham tshar bar byed pa yin pas zhes slob dpon gyis brda sprad cing ma tshar bar ngag bcad de bya'o/ /gsum pa ni de nas oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na nas sngags lan gsum 'don pa'i bar srung 'khor sgom mo/ /de nas slob ma rnams re re nas drung du phyin pa la/ slob dpon gyis rang la rim gyi rtogs pa bzang po byung ba na yi dam gyi lhas zhal bstan te dngos grub ster ba'ang srid/

nang stobs 'phel te yi dam gyi lha'i rnam par bstan te bar chad byed pa'ang srid/ nyams kyi snang ba la yi dam lha'i rnam par 'char ba'ang srid/ de gsum gang byung yang gzugs ston pa rang gis bsgoms pa'i yid dam gyi lha'i rnam par snang ba dang / sgra brjod pa ni rang bzla ba'i sngags de brjod pa sogs la rnam gsum rigs dbye dgos te/ de yang yi dam gyi lha yin na brda bstan pas gsang mtshan nas lung ston cing dngos grub ster bar byed la/ bdud kyi bar chad yin na brda bstan pas skyengs te log 'gro zhing / nyams snang yin na brda bstan pas mi 'gyur ba yin pas/ de lta bu nam byung ba'i tshe brda bstan par bya ste/ de yang bar chad dang po ngag la 'jug pa yin pas/ de lta bu byung na lab shor nyen yod pas so bsdams mchu btsum ste lab mi bya zhing / chos gos la sogs pa'i phag tu brda' bcas te/ 'di ci'i brda yin yid kyis dris te/ lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan pa dang / /mtheb srin e la reg byed gcig /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang / /mdzub mo nam mkha' mtshon pa 'o/ /zhes pa rtsa ba'i brda tshig go /yan lag gi brda ni bdud kyis bslad pas rtsa ba'i brda brjed nyen yod pas brda theb lta bur dgos te/ sor mo lnga ni phul te bstan/ /rdo rje khu tshur mi phyed 'gyur/ /rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar te bstan/ /mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa 'o/ /zhes yan lag gi brda bzhi 'am/ ngag gi brda bzhi ni bum dbang gi ka la sha a/ gsang dbang gi ya ra la wa/ gsum pa'i e bam̐ ma ya/ bzhi pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ste bzhi tshan bzhi'o/ /lus brda dang ngag gi brda 'di rnams gnas gang du phyag rgya gang 'cha' zhing / yi ge gang 'god pa dang / brda tshig gi go don gyi bshad pa rnams ni bla ma dam pa'i gsung dang / gzhung bshad chen mo rnams kyi bsrung ba sum cu'i skabs las shes par bya ste/ 'di ches cher gsang ba yin pa'i phyir skabs 'dir rgyas par ma bris so/

/de nas slob ma rnams re re nas brda bstan cing bshad pa tshar nas yol ba'i phyi rol tu rang rang gi gdan la 'khod do/ /srung 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba rnams rdzogs par bya'o/ /bzhi pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa dang / maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong zhing / slob dpon gyis gtor ma'i mjug gi cho ga rnams rdzogs par byas la bsngo ba smon lam bkris rnams rgyas par bya'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir rje btsun ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni mdun du maṇḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa'i steng du nas nag po'i tshom bu gcig dgod/ de'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma rgya che ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa gcig bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu yang bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyai rdor dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed gur nas 'byung ba ltar gyi nag po chen po yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa bya/ mdun gyi maṇḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nag po chen po bdag bskyed ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / nang bdud rtsis mchod/ bstod pas kyang bstod/ gtor ma kyai rdor ltar byin gyis brlabs nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum dang / sngags ring lan gsum gyis dbul/ slar yang phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gsung gi khrid kyis smin pa gcig bos la khrus byas/ yon dang maṇḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs tshig rkang drug dang / kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ de nas slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma ro'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nas/

'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las nag po chen por bskyed pa'i dmigs pa dpon slob gnyis char gyis bya/ de'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs kyai rdor bzhin/ ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug gi rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bskul/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas nag po chen po spyan drangs nas slob ma la thim par dmigs nas rol mo bya/ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas rgyas btab nas dbang gi lha rnams bstim/ spyi bor me tog bzhag nas rab tu gnas par bya ste/ de ltar slob ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ba ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /de nas sngags thung dang sngags ring gnyis kyi bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni spyi dang mthun/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ngo sprad nas de'i ngang la bzhag pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i mgo bor gtor ma/ slob dpon gyi phreng ba slob ma'i mgul du bskon pa slob dpon gyi phyag gis 'jus nas bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod do/ /de dag gi bka' dang dam las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs rjes gnang spyi'i bka' sgo dang / khyad par gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa la 'jig rten chos kyi bar chad/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad/ bdud stobs 'phel ba'i bar chad rnams mi 'byung ba dang / khams 'dus pa gsum mthar phyin nas tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' snyogs pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub tu gsol/ rang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas snod ldan gyi gdul bya la dbang gis smin par byas nas khrid dang gdam ngag tshul bzhin tu bstan pa'i sgo nas gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bka' bsgo bya/

rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang mthun/ 'di'i bsgrub pa dang las sbyor rnams gur nas 'byung ba de nyid yin zhing / phyag mtshan la gaṇṭe med par gsungs la/ zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul zhi ba la g.yas brkyangs/ drag po la g.yon brkyangs/ dbang la sa ga rgyas pa la zlum por bya ba gsungs so/ /bdag mdun gang la'ang dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i tshe sa bon tsam las bskyed pa'am/ rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa ni gang byas kyang 'dra'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi byin rlabs kyi rim pa'i phyag len la gsum ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas mkha' 'gro mnyes par bya ba dang / phyi nang gi rten 'brel bsgrigs te lung sbyin pa dang / dam bzhag bzhis rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin bsgrub par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni slob dpon gyis dus khyad par can la gnas dben par rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dang / brda chig brgyud kyi skabs ltar mchod gtor phul/ grub na tshogs 'khor yang byas la phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni rang la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs khrid/ gzhung gi bshad pa la sogs pa gdams ngag rdzogs par thob pa'i slob ma lnga tshun chad bos la/ bshad pa ci rigs pa byas nas bsgrub pa lung sbyin gyi gdam ngag zab mo zhu ba'i yon dang / maṇḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs dang / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de nas slob dpon kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba dngos yin mnyam pa'i mos gus drag po byas nas/ dang po byin gyis brlab pa dngos zhu ba'i don du gsol gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun/ /'bar g.yo brtan pa'i bye brag gis/ /srog rtsol 'gog pa de bzhin no/ /bde chen chos sku nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis bdag med ma dang birwa pa nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan brjod nas/ deng slan chad khyed kyi rgyud la bla ma snga ma snga mas slob ma la bsgrub pa'i lung byin cing de'i byin rlabs zhugs pas/ ngo bo zung 'jug rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa gdon mi za bar skye ba yin zhing / de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas bsgrub pa mthar phyin zhing / grub pa'i 'bras bus gdul bya dpag tu med pa la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing me tog gtor/ gzhung las bar chad bsal ba sngon la yod kyang / bla mas sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa sngon la mdzad kyin 'dug pas de bzhin bris pa yin no/ /dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de sogs gzhung du lan re las ma bshad kyang / bla mas lan gsum gsum mdzad pas de bzhin bris pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bar chad bsal ba ni slob dpon gyis de ltar bsgrub pa'i lung thob nas/ de la gegs sam bar chad 'byung srid pas de mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de sogs sngar ltar ro/ /slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma 'di lam bsgrub pa la phyi nang gi bgegs dang bar chad thams cad mi 'byung bar gyur cig /dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par bsrung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sba ba'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ des ni khyed kyi lam zab mo yan lag dang bcas pa brtson 'grus dang bstun pa'i bye brag gis ji ltar rigs pa bsgrub kyang dgos la/ de ltar bsgrub pa la phyi rol bdud la sogs pa'i bar du gcod pa rnams kyang mi 'byung ba'i lung thob pa yin no/

/zhes gsungs bzhin me tog gtor ro/ /gsum pa gzhan don bya ba la 'jug pa ni/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i lung thob cing bar chad dang bral nas gzhan don byed dgos pas/ gzhan don phrin las 'byung ba'i phyir du gsol gdab 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor lnga la sogs sngar ltar ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi lam sgrub pa'i byin rlabs thob nas lam bsgrub pa'i bar chad dang bral zhing lam 'di'i sgo nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa de bzhin du/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyis lam bsgrub pa'i lung dang byin rlabs thob nas lam bsgrub pa'i bar chad dang bral zhing lam 'di'i sgo nas 'dul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad par gyur cig deng slan chad khyod la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gzhan don byed pa'i mthu dang ldan par mdzad pas/ yongs su brtags pa'i slob ma la cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du smin par bya ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bya ba la mthu dang ldan pa'i lung thob pa yin no zhes gsung zhing me tog gtor ro/ /gnyis pa dam bzhag bzhi dbang chu chen mo nas gsungs skabs 'dir dgos pa'i phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i dam bzhag la dgos pa'i chu ni sngar gyi bum chu rnying pa'i rgyun gyis rung gsungs/ pa bzhin mdzad do/ /de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs pas dam du sba zhing dam du spel zhes sogs kyi bshad pa ci rigs pa mdzad nas chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bsgrub pa lung sbyin gyi dpe cha'i lung yang mdzad do/ /zhang spe dmar bas 'di'i skabs su gnya' bar mgon po'i sku bzhag ske la phreng ba bskon nas dam bzhag bya gsung ba'ang chos la gtsigs su byed pa'i gtam yin gsungs so/ /rjes kyi bya ba gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / maṇḍal dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod do/ /de nas dge rtsa bsngos la slob ma rang gnas su gtang ngo /

/slob dpon gyis maṇḍal sgrub mchod byas na rjes chog dgos kyang / 'dir bdag bskyed rkyang pa la brten pa'i gtor 'bul tsam byas pas chog gsungs so/ /zhes gsung ngag rin po che'i cha lag brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi phyag len gsal bar bkod pa'i yi ge don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin slu med kyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i chos med kyi rnal 'byor ba sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung rgyun dang phyag len ji lta ba bzhin rang gi dran pa gso ba dang don gnyer gzhan la'ang phan pa'i bsam pas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar du sug bris bgyis pa 'di'i dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ lam 'bras kyi cha lag brda don gsal ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
